title: 第17章 家族议事第18章 族比定主
content_zh:
叶云河听完叶霄尘的话，暗自摇头。
相比大哥，他自知在管理家族方面确实没什么天赋，否则也不会连个猎妖队都经营不善。
小尘啊……叶云河刚要开口，却被叶霄尘直接打断。
三叔，叶霄尘神色肃然，我想坐上家主的位置。
叶云河一怔，仿佛没听清：你说什么？
我要接替父亲的位置。
叶霄尘一字一顿地重复道。
叶云河又愣了一下，随即失笑：别闹了小尘，你叔我都没想做家主，更何况你……
话未说完，他突然发现侄子脸上没有半点玩笑的意思。
叶霄尘沉声分析：三叔，您觉得大长老会因为权力背叛叶家吗？
叶云河摇头：怎么可能？他上了年纪，怎么都轮不到他做族长。
既然一个不可能背叛叶家的人都坐不上族长之位，而您又不想坐这个位置...
叶霄尘目光如炬，
我父亲身为玄罡境巅峰强者，却轻易死在外面，这事绝不简单。
若让叶家落入叛徒之手，岂不是辜负了父亲的心血？
叶云河凝视着侄子良久，最终叹了口气：小尘，算了吧。
咱爷俩一个刚解决废体踏入修行之路，一个玄罡境一重这么多年都没突破，就别折腾了。
你能平安过完这一生，三叔就满足了。
三叔不必多虑，叶霄尘坚定道，您只要支持我就行。
好吧。

叶云河无奈妥协，
你长大了有自己的想法，三叔不多劝。
但万事以安全为重。
眼下最要紧的是提升修为。
叶霄尘话锋一转，三叔现在修炼什么功法？
还能是什么？家族传承的《青元功》啊。
叶霄尘取出一个玉简：换这个吧。
《玄罡化龙诀》，凡阶顶级功法。
您先练着，日后有更好的再换。
叶云河接过玉简，神识一扫，顿时震惊：你哪来的功法？
三叔不必多问。
叶霄尘又取出一枚玉简，
这是配套的凡阶顶级玄技《玄罡化龙掌》，您一起练。
叶霄尘也想过将自己修炼的《周天星辰诀》交给三叔修炼，
但三叔毕竟不是叶寒星，他有足够的见识和自己的意见，
要是让他发现什么不对，盘根问底之下，叶霄尘自己也很为难，
所以，只能先委屈一下他的亲三叔，先将就一下修炼护卫队修炼的《玄罡化龙诀》了。
不过，要是让叶云河知道他这个侄子心中所想，估计会忍不住暴走，
content_en:
After hearing what Ye Xiaochen said, Ye Yunhe shook his head secretly.
Compared to his eldest brother, he knew that he really had no talent in managing the family, otherwise he would not be able to run a demon hunting team well.
Xiaochen... Ye Yunhe was about to speak, but was directly interrupted by Ye Xiaochen.
Third uncle, Ye Xiaochen looked solemn, I want to sit in the position of the head of the family.
Ye Yunhe was startled, as if he didn't hear clearly: What did you say?
I want to take my father's place.
Ye Xiaochen repeated word for word.
Ye Yunhe was stunned for a second, then laughed: Don't make trouble, Xiaochen, your uncle and I don't even want to be the head of the family, let alone you...
Before he finished speaking, he suddenly realized that there was no hint of joking on his nephew's face.
Ye Xiaochen analyzed in a deep voice: Third uncle, do you think the Great Elder will betray the Ye family because of his power?
Ye Yunhe shook his head: How is that possible? He is old and it is not his turn to be the leader of the clan.
Since a person who is unlikely to betray the Ye family cannot sit in the position of patriarch, and you don’t want to sit in this position...
Ye Xiaochen's eyes were as bright as a torch,
My father was a powerful person at the pinnacle of the Xuangang Realm, but he died outside so easily. This matter is by no means simple.
If the Ye family fell into the hands of traitors, wouldn't it be a failure of his father's hard work?
Ye Yunhe stared at his nephew for a long time, and finally sighed: Xiaochen, forget it.
The two of us have just gotten rid of the waste body and embarked on the path of cultivation, while the other has not broken through the first level of Xuan Gang Realm for so many years, so don't worry about it.
If you can live this life safely, Third Uncle will be satisfied.
Third uncle, there is no need to worry too much, Ye Xiaochen said firmly, as long as you support me.
All right.
Ye Yunhe had no choice but to compromise.
When you grow up, you will have your own ideas, and your third uncle won’t try to persuade you.
But safety is the top priority in everything.
The most important thing right now is to improve your cultivation.
Ye Xiaochen changed the topic, what kind of exercises does the third uncle practice now?
What else could it be? The "Qing Yuan Gong" passed down by the family.
Ye Xiaochen took out a jade slip: Let's change it to this one.
"Xuan Gang Dragon Transformation Technique" is a top-notch skill at the ordinary level.
You practice first, and then switch to something better in the future.
Ye Yunhe took the jade slip, glanced at it with his consciousness, and was suddenly shocked: Where did you get the technique?
Third uncle doesn’t need to ask any more questions.
Ye Xiaochen took out another jade slip.
This is the accompanying top mortal level mysterious skill "Xuan Gang Dragon Transformation Palm", you can practice it together.
Ye Xiaochen also thought about giving the "Zhou Tian Xing Jue" he practiced to his third uncle to practice.
But the third uncle is not Ye Hanxing after all. He has enough knowledge and opinions of his own.
If he found out something was wrong, Ye Xiaochen would be in trouble himself after questioning him.
Therefore, he could only aggrieve his third uncle and practice the "Xuan Gang Dragon Transformation Technique" practiced by the escort team.
However, if Ye Yunhe knew what his nephew was thinking, he would probably go berserk.
